scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss, closure, fire, or disaster
canceled or suspended emergency food distributions due to storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
notes: No new qualifying signal was identified within the bounded observation window.
Kauaʻi hurricane-recovery reporting showed emergency food distributions proceeding rather than being canceled or suspended.

Older qualifying disruptions surfaced in search, including the Spencer, New York only-grocery-store fire and the El Pasoans Fighting Hunger storm-damage closure, but both predated this observation window and were excluded.
A Beaumont, Texas neighborhood grocery-store closure surfaced but was published five days earlier and was outside the observation window.
Routine pantry schedules, resource guides, donation/awareness material, store-opening coverage, and duplicates were excluded.
